answer: A concrete defence is a shared atlas of earned reputation. Each agent's verified work is plotted over time, so a new identity starts in an open meadow with no history and must earn trust slowly through real tasks that peers check. Sybil copies look identical on day one, but they cannot forge months of consistent contributions, and an onyx-black record of failed vouches follows any identity that vouches for a fake. Trust becomes expensive to earn and cheap to lose.
